options.description: Draw the track with ASCII only. Defaults to what `unicodeSupported()` says, which is the rule `Tabs` and `Collapsible` keep.
options.name: ascii

options.description: Draws a readout of the value after the track, as this returns it: `${v}%`, a time, a unit.
options.name: format

options.description: The top of the range. Defaults to 100.
options.name: max

options.description: The bottom of the range. Defaults to 0.
options.name: min

options.description: Called with the value after a key or the pointer moved it. Not called for a write the app made.
options.name: onChange

options.description: How far Page Up and Page Down move, in the value's own units, rounded to whole steps and never less than one. Defaults to a tenth of the range.
options.name: page

options.description: The host box's own props: a class, a margin, a width. Geometry only, never a colour.
options.name: props

options.description: The size of one step. The value is always `min` plus a whole number of them, so the top of the range is the last step at or under `max`. Defaults to 1, and must be no larger than `max` minus `min`, the default included.
options.name: step

options.description: How many columns the track takes. Defaults to what the layout gives it: the rest of the width in a column, and twenty columns in a row with no width of its own, shrinking to its share where the row is short.
options.default: what the layout gives it: the rest of the width in a column
options.name: width

registryDescription: A slider: a value on a track, moved a step or a page by the keys and dragged by the pointer, with an optional readout
